description: Search GitDiagram's library of ready-made architecture diagrams of public GitHub repositories by owner or repository name. Matches any part of "owner/repo" (e.g. "langchain", "vercel/", "react-native") and returns up to 10 repositories, most-starred first, each with its interactive diagram link. Use it to find a project's exact owner/repo from its name, or to list which repositories of an owner or topic already have diagrams. It searches repository names only, not code or file contents.

limit.description: How many repositories to return (1–10, default 10).

query.description: Part of a repository's "owner/repo" name, e.g. "fastapi", "microsoft/", or "next.js".

name: find_repository_diagrams
title: Search GitDiagram's architecture diagrams
